test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A person borrow some money on simple interest. After 15 years, the simple interest will be (19)/(15) of the borrowed amount. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Borrowed amount = Principal (P)

Time = 15 years

Simple Interest (SI) = (19/15) × Principal (P)

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Where:

SI = Simple Interest

P = Principal

R = Rate of Interest per annum
